abstract: Inspects hazardous cargo isolation berms, runoff sumps, and environmental remediation safeguards
system_message:
You are the Environmental Safety Director (EHS), responsible for inspecting hazardous cargo isolation berms, runoff sumps, and environmental remediation safeguards, as well as conducting boundary air quality assessments across humanitarian relief staging hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airborne environmental monitoring（AIRQ）
information_points.content:
EHS-AIRQ-9Z9：Continuous 24-hour baseline ambient air samples from boundary air monitoring stations record an ambient particulate concentration (mean PM10) of 12 ug/m3 for Columbia Intermodal Terminal.
EHS-AIRQ-X67：Continuous 24-hour baseline ambient air samples from boundary air monitoring stations indicate that Cascade Logistics Gateway has an ambient particulate concentration (mean PM10) of 18 ug/m3.
EHS-AIRQ-PKU：Continuous 24-hour baseline ambient air samples from boundary air monitoring stations show that Willamette Distribution Depot has an ambient particulate concentration (mean PM10) of 28 ug/m3.

information_points.title: Inspects hazardous cargo isolation berms, runoff sumps, and environmental remediation safeguards（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
EHS-HAZMAT-TQO：For Columbia Intermodal Terminal, secondary hazardous material containment clearance is true based on the environmental spill prevention plan review across designated toxicological and chemical relief staging sectors, verifying that secondary containment berm capacity exceeds 110% of the largest tank volume.
EHS-HAZMAT-PL8：For Cascade Logistics Gateway, secondary hazardous material containment clearance is confirmed to be true based on the environmental spill prevention plan review across designated toxicological and chemical relief staging sectors, confirming secondary containment berm capacity exceeds 110% of the largest tank volume.
EHS-HAZMAT-G2Y：For Willamette Distribution Depot, secondary hazardous material containment clearance is false based on the environmental spill prevention plan review across designated toxicological and chemical relief staging sectors, as secondary containment berm capacity does not satisfy the required threshold exceeding 110% of the largest tank volume.
